description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing River Kelpie.
When River Kelpie dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil, Blasting Station and River Kelpie trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Thran Vigil trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on River Kelpie.
Resolve the River Kelpie trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.
